market.icp: Privacy-conscious meeting participants who need local-first notes
market.buyerPain: Exported notes can receive awkward filenames with leading separators, lost accents, or no meaningful basename, making handoff and filing feel unfinished.
market.revenueHypothesis: Predictable, readable Markdown filenames make SideNote exports easier to identify and share while preserving the local-first workflow.

increment.name: export-filename-polish
acceptanceCriteria: Every Markdown export receives a lowercase .md filename without leading, trailing, or repeated separators.
Latin accents are normalized so common meeting titles remain readable in the downloaded filename.
Punctuation-only titles fall back to sidenote-meeting.md.
The filename basename is capped at 80 characters without leaving a trailing separator.
Both active-note and library export actions continue through the shared exportMarkdown path.
The increment introduces no CSS, dependency, share API, network, account, provider, storage, or billing change.
The focused export contract, all local contracts, TypeScript, and production build pass locally.
LICENSE, dependency manifests, credentials, providers, billing, and deployment configuration remain unchanged.

delivery.checker: Codex separate local verification; independent checker unavailable in this bounded single-agent slice
delivery.rollback: Revert only the export filename polish commit on feat/sidenote-export-filename.
delivery.stopCondition: Stop after one verified export-polish increment; do not merge, deploy, submit to an app store, spend, change credentials, or change licensing.
